investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agents feature, production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-23T16:25 with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 — was unreachable. Because the failure occurs at the very first network call to POST /api/agents, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, and the expected-output contract is entirely unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway backing the remote agent provisioning path (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents) returned a connection-level error to the production-api layer, which surfaced as HTTP 502 bad_gateway on POST /api/agents. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm ELB endpoint in us-east-2, not an eval runner defect. All three sibling checks share the identical error message and all produced empty evidence objects, confirming the failure is upstream of any per-check logic in run-status-probes.mjs.

investigation.title: image-generation-stream Eval Failure: OpenAI API Credit Balance Exhausted on /api/generate/image/stream
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval runner has no remaining credits, causing the upstream image generation call to return a credit_balance_exhausted error. The stream terminated with a generation_error frame instead of the required generation_completed frame, so both contract assertions (frameTypes contains "generation_completed" and imageUrlPresent equals true) were violated. This is an eval infrastructure / API credential failure, not a user-facing product outage.
investigation.rootCause: The OpenAI API account associated with the eval runner's credentials has exhausted its credit balance (error code: credit_balance_exhausted, type: insufficient_quota). When the runner called /api/generate/image/stream, the backend forwarded the request to OpenAI, received a quota error, and emitted a generation_error SSE frame instead of completing the generation. No image URL was produced, and the generation_completed frame required by the expected-output contract was never emitted. The failure is localized to the eval runner's OpenAI billing account and does not, by itself, prove that production user traffic is impacted.
proof: failed-check.message: OpenAI error code credit_balance_exhausted with message 'You have no credits remaining. Add credits to continue using the API at https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/.'

failed-check.evidence: generation_error frame data contains code GENERATION_FAILED and the full OpenAI insufficient_quota error body
expected-output.contract: assertions require frameTypes contains 'generation_completed' and imageUrlPresent equals true — both violated
failed-check.timing: latencyMs=1387, well under the warningLatencyMs=180000 threshold, confirming the request was rejected immediately by the upstream API rather than timing out
